CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)

   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
